Course References

Books and Readings

The course readings point to open and durable resources. This page is a visual library for finding books, guides and useful chapters.

Main references Module readings

Main References

These resources cover the core of the course: R, visualization, transformation, statistical exploration, communication and reproducibility.

Wickham, Çetinkaya-Rundel and Grolemund

R for Data Science, 2nd edition

Main reference for the tidyverse, import, transformation, visualization, dates, joins and communication.

Open the book

Çetinkaya-Rundel and Hardin

Introduction to Modern Statistics

Complement for numerical exploration, inference, statistical intuition and applied interpretation.

Open the book

Diez, Cetinkaya-Rundel and Barr

OpenIntro Statistics

Open reference for reviewing statistical foundations and uncertainty reasoning.

Open the resource
Text Mining
with R

Silge and Robinson

Text Mining with R

Module 10 reference for turning text into tidy data, counting words and building lexical analyses.

Open the book

Module Readings

This summary helps you quickly find the references called by the learning plans.

Module 01

R for Data Science for the workflow and Quarto for the HTML report.

Module 02

R for Data Science: visualization, transformation, exploration, spreadsheets and first numerical summaries.

Module 03

R for Data Science: strings and recoding guidance for categorical variables.

Module 04

R for Data Science: import, tidy data, factors, spreadsheets and nested data.

Module 05

Exploratory data analysis, dates and tidy organization for studying relationships between variables.

Module 06

GitHub Docs, Quarto inline code and joins with R for Data Science.

Module 07

Communication with R for Data Science and reflection on the limits of visualization.

Module 08

Web scraping with R for Data Science to understand HTML, CSS and extraction.

Module 09

Targeted review of prediction, validation and bias concepts in the module material.

Module 10

Text Mining with R, flexdashboard documentation and Shiny documentation.
